variables.name: Air temperature
variables.definition: How warm the air is about 2 metres above the ground, averaged over day and night.

variables.name: Hottest temperature
variables.definition: How hot the hottest hour of the day gets, 2 metres above the ground, on average.

variables.name: Coldest temperature
variables.definition: How cold the coldest hour of the day gets, 2 metres above the ground, on average.

variables.name: Temperature swing
variables.definition: The gap between the hottest and the coldest hour of the day, on average.

variables.name: Ground surface temperature
variables.definition: How warm the surface of the land or sea itself is, not the air above it.

variables.name: Dew point
variables.definition: The temperature at which the air would become saturated and dew or frost would form. Higher means muggier air.

variables.name: Frost days
variables.definition: How many days were cold enough for frost to form (air below 0 °C).

variables.name: Precipitation
variables.definition: How much water falls from the sky as rain or snow, on an average day.

variables.name: Evaporation from land
variables.definition: How much water leaves the land surface and goes back into the air.

variables.name: Relative humidity
variables.definition: How full of water vapour the air is, compared with the most it could hold.

variables.name: Moisture in the air
variables.definition: Grams of water vapour in each kilogram of air near the ground.

variables.name: Water vapour in the air column (model)
variables.definition: All the water vapour in the air above one square metre of ground, from a global weather model.

variables.name: Water vapour in the air column (CERES)
variables.definition: All the water vapour in the air above one square metre of ground, from the CERES satellite data product.

variables.name: Cloud cover
variables.definition: The share of the sky covered by clouds.

variables.name: Topsoil wetness
variables.definition: How wet the top 5 cm of soil is, from 0 (completely dry) to 1 (soaked).

variables.name: Root-zone soil wetness
variables.definition: How wet the top metre of soil is, where plant roots drink. 0 is dry, 1 is soaked.

variables.name: Deep soil wetness
variables.definition: How wet the whole soil layer is, from the surface down to bedrock. 0 is dry, 1 is soaked.

variables.name: Snow depth
variables.definition: How deep the snow lying on the ground is.

variables.name: Snow cover
variables.definition: The share of the land covered by snow, from 0 (none) to 1 (all).

variables.name: Snowfall
variables.definition: How much water falls as snow over land, on an average day.

variables.name: Sunlight reaching the ground
variables.definition: The energy from the Sun that reaches the ground, clouds included.

variables.name: Sunlight under a clear sky
variables.definition: The energy from the Sun that would reach the ground if there were no clouds. It changes when the air gets hazier or cleaner.

variables.name: Heat radiated down by the sky
variables.definition: The invisible heat radiation that the air and clouds send down to the ground.

variables.name: UV index
variables.definition: How strong the Sun's skin-burning ultraviolet rays are at the ground.

variables.name: Surface brightness (albedo)
variables.definition: The share of sunlight the ground reflects back. Snow and sand are bright, forests and oceans are dark.

variables.name: Haze (aerosol optical depth)
variables.definition: How much dust, smoke and pollution particles in the air block sunlight. Higher means hazier air.

variables.name: Cloud thickness
variables.definition: How much the clouds block light passing through them. Higher means thicker clouds.

variables.name: Ozone layer
variables.definition: The total amount of ozone in the air above, the gas that shields us from ultraviolet rays.

variables.name: Air pressure
variables.definition: The weight of the air pressing down on the ground.

variables.name: Wind speed
variables.definition: How fast the air moves 10 metres above the ground.

variables.name: Wind speed higher up
variables.definition: How fast the air moves 50 metres above the ground, the height of a wind turbine.

themes.label: Heat
themes.question: Is it getting hotter or colder?
themes.description: Air and ground temperatures, extremes and frost.

themes.label: Water in the air
themes.question: Is it getting wetter or drier?

themes.label: Soil
themes.question: Is the ground drying out?
themes.description: How much water the soil holds.

themes.label: Snow
themes.question: Is the snow disappearing?
themes.description: Snowfall, snow depth and snow cover.

themes.label: Sunlight
themes.question: Is more or less sunlight getting through?
themes.description: Solar energy at the ground, UV and surface brightness.

themes.label: Air
themes.question: Is the air changing?
themes.description: Haze, ozone, cloud thickness and pressure.
